weather_report:
Jolimont sits in the small hours under a cloudless dome, the night clear and hushed, as if the city has paused to listen to its own breathing. Air feels clean on the skin and the stars hold steady; it’s the sort of stillness that makes the streets seem longer and the trees more patient.

Toward dawn, the forecast stays faithful to clarity: a bright, open sky through sunrise and into the morning, with crisp shadows and a sun that gathers strength quickly. Expect a very sunny start and a UV bite that builds after breakfast, so think light layers you can shed, sunglasses, and sunscreen; a brimmed hat would not be out of place. It looks like an easy, pleasant morning—good for catching an early tram, a gentle loop through Fitzroy Gardens, airing out the flat, or hanging a small wash while the light turns warm. If you’re heading out, enjoy the calm first light, then favor shade and a steady pace once the sun sharpens.
